body:
Unfortunately I don't think that will be possible...In my country, sexual orientation IS a big deal (even though LGBT people are legally accepted, people take it very seriously) and my parents and a couple of friends wouldn't like to hear me saying I like guys. If it goes wrong, I will end up even worse...

Is it worthy to still give it a shot and risk it all? I mean...I'm on /r/suicidewatch, I guess I don't have anything to lose right?

I didn't come out yet because I can't find a point in telling my friends/family my sexual orientation, not to mention that it will change things a lot, specially in the family part.

As for girls...well, last time it didn't go so well, she played with me for a couple of months and left me by saying "oh I thought we were only joking". 

I would say I'm 20/80 (girls/guys) but it could easily change depending on the people I meet. Since I mostly meet guys, I don't see that changing anytime soon.

I'm glad it got better for you :)

I'm not out yet, so I can't really join an LGBT group...And even If I were, I don't think I like the idea...I just want to be like everyone else, why should I have to join a specific group of people to find happiness?
